curriculum.title: Curriculum Structure — BSc in Physics with Secondary Major in AIDA / IE
content: **Programme Overview**: This is a 4-year full-time programme combining a solid foundation in physics with a secondary major in either **Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics (AIDA)** or **Innovation and Entrepreneurship (IE)**. Students graduate with a BSc in Physics and a designated secondary major, enhancing interdisciplinary expertise.

**Two Streams**: Students choose between **AIDA** (focus on AI, machine learning, and big data) and **IE** (focus on innovation, startup management, and technology commercialisation). The secondary major comprises approximately 30–36 credits.

**Year 1**: Foundational courses in **physics** (mechanics, electromagnetism, thermodynamics), **mathematics** (calculus, linear algebra), and **general university requirements** (language, critical thinking). Introduction to the secondary major through exploratory modules.

**Year 2**: Core physics courses including **quantum mechanics**, **statistical physics**, and **computational physics**. Secondary major courses begin in earnest — AIDA students take programming and data structures; IE students take entrepreneurship and design thinking.

**Year 3**: Advanced physics electives (e.g., **solid state physics**, **astrophysics**) and deepening of secondary major. AIDA students study deep learning and data mining; IE students study venture financing and intellectual property. **Work-Integrated Education (WIE)** placement is typically undertaken this year.

**Year 4**: Capstone **Final Year Project** in physics, integrating the secondary major. Remaining secondary major courses and electives. Graduates are well-prepared for cross-disciplinary careers or further study.

career.title: Career Prospects — Physics + AIDA/IE Graduates
content: **High Demand Sectors**: Graduates are sought after in **technology**, **finance**, **data science**, and **R&D**. The combination of physics problem-solving with AIDA or IE skills opens doors to roles like **data scientist**, **quantitative analyst**, and **innovation manager**.

**AIDA Pathway**: With the secondary major in AIDA, typical roles include **machine learning engineer**, **AI specialist**, and **big data analyst** at firms like Google, HSBC, or local tech startups. The average starting salary for PolyU science graduates is around HKD 20,000–25,000 per month.

**IE Pathway**: The IE secondary major prepares students for **entrepreneurship**, **technology consulting**, and **product management**. Graduates may launch their own ventures or join accelerators like **Cyberport** or **Hong Kong Science Park**.

**Further Study**: Many graduates pursue **MPhil/PhD** in physics, data science, or related fields at top universities worldwide, including PolyU’s own research centres in **photonics** and **materials science**.

**Industry Connections**: PolyU’s **Work-Integrated Education (WIE)** programme places students in companies such as **CLP Power**, **MTR Corporation**, and **ASTRI**, providing direct industry exposure and networking opportunities.

**Greater Bay Area Opportunities**: The programme leverages PolyU’s strong ties with the **Greater Bay Area**, offering internships and job placements in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and other innovation hubs.

campus.title: Campus Life & Facilities — PolyU Hung Hom
content: **Prime Location**: PolyU is located in **Hung Hom**, Kowloon, with direct MTR access via the **Hung Hom Station** (East Rail Line and Tuen Ma Line). The campus is minutes from **Tsim Sha Tsui** and the **Kowloon waterfront**.

**Science Facilities**: The **Department of Applied Physics** boasts modern laboratories for **laser physics**, **nanotechnology**, and **materials characterization**. Students have access to the **University Research Facility** for advanced experiments.

**Library & Learning Commons**: The **Pao Yue-kong Library** houses extensive physics journals, e-books, and collaborative spaces. The **Learning Commons** offers 24/7 study areas and group project rooms.

**Student Accommodation**: PolyU provides on-campus halls for non-local students, with priority for first-year undergraduates. Halls are within walking distance and feature common rooms, gyms, and dining facilities.

**Clubs & Societies**: The **Physics Society** organizes academic talks, lab visits, and social events. Students can also join the **AIDA Club** or **Entrepreneurship Society** to network with peers and industry professionals.
**Sports & Recreation**: The campus includes a **sports centre** with a swimming pool, basketball courts, and a fitness centre. The nearby **Hung Hom Promenade** is ideal for jogging and relaxation.

competitiveness.title: Competitiveness & Admission — JS3030
content: **Overall Level**: High (★★★★☆)

**Admission Score Formula**: **Any Best 5 Subjects** (plus 6th subject bonus). This means applicants can include their top 5 HKDSE results, with an additional bonus for a 6th subject, maximizing flexibility.

**Subject Weighting**: Physics, Mathematics (Compulsory), and M1/M2 are given **higher weighting** (typically 1.5x to 2x). Other subjects like Chemistry, Biology, and English are also weighted favourably. Check the official PolyU website for exact coefficients.
**Average Weighted Score (2025)**: The **average HKDSE score with subject weighting** is **260.6**. This is the benchmark for competitive applicants — scores above this significantly improve chances.

**Median & Lower Quartile**: Median and lower quartile scores for 2025 are listed as **N/A**, indicating that this is a relatively new programme or data is not yet released. Applicants should aim for scores above the average to be safe.

**Interview Requirement**: Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an **interview** (typically in English) to assess motivation, problem-solving skills, and interest in physics and the secondary major. Prepare to discuss your academic background and career goals.

scholarships.title: Scholarships & Financial Support — PolyU
content: **PolyU Entrance Scholarship**: Awarded to HKDSE top scorers (e.g., 5** or above in multiple subjects). Covers full or partial tuition fees, with a maximum of **HKD 100,000** per year for outstanding applicants.

**Faculty of Science Scholarships**: The **Faculty of Science** offers merit-based scholarships for students with strong academic performance, including those in JS3030. Awards range from **HKD 10,000 to HKD 50,000**.
**Dr. Ng Tat-lung Memorial Scholarship**: Specifically for physics students with excellent academic records and research potential. Valued at **HKD 20,000** annually.

**Work-Integrated Education (WIE) Allowance**: Students on WIE placements may receive a **monthly allowance** (up to HKD 5,000) from the university or host company, reducing financial burden during internships.

**Government Financial Assistance**: Eligible students can apply for the **TSFS** (means-tested) or **NLSFT** (non-means-tested) loans from the Hong Kong government, plus the **Grant for Prospective Teachers** if applicable.
**External Scholarships**: PolyU physics students have won prestigious awards like the **Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme** and **Croucher Foundation Scholarships** for postgraduate studies.

tips.title: Ace Sir's JS3030 Strategy — 9 Actionable Tips
content: **1. Master the Weighting Formula**: Focus on **Physics, Mathematics (Compulsory), and M1/M2** as they are weighted 1.5x–2x. A 5* in Physics counts more than a 5* in Liberal Studies. Allocate study time accordingly.
- Calculate your weighted score using the formula: (Subject Score × Weight) summed for best 5, plus 6th subject bonus (5% of raw score). Aim for a weighted total above **260.6**.

**2. Excel in Physics and Math**: These are the core subjects. Practice past HKDSE papers and focus on **experimental design** and **data analysis** questions. A strong performance here can compensate for weaker electives.
- For M1/M2, master calculus and probability — these are directly relevant to both AIDA and IE streams.

**3. Build a Strong Profile for Interview**: If shortlisted, prepare to discuss **why physics + AIDA/IE**. Read about current trends in AI or entrepreneurship. Have a specific example of a project or problem you solved.
- Practice answering in English: 'How can physics principles be applied to machine learning?' or 'Describe a startup idea you have.'
**4. Leverage the 6th Subject Bonus**: Take an extra elective (e.g., Chemistry, Economics) to boost your score. Even a Level 4 in a 6th subject adds **5% of its raw score** to your total.
- Choose a subject where you can score at least Level 4 — don't overload yourself.

**5. Research the Secondary Major Options**: Decide between **AIDA** and **IE** early. AIDA suits those interested in data science; IE suits future entrepreneurs. Tailor your personal statement accordingly.
- Visit PolyU’s website for sample curriculum of each stream to see which aligns with your goals.
**6. Use the 'Any Best 5' to Your Advantage**: If you have a weak subject (e.g., Liberal Studies), drop it from your calculation. Focus on your 5 strongest subjects, including Physics and Math.
- For example, if you score 5* in Physics, 5 in Math, 5 in M2, 4 in Chemistry, and 4 in English, that’s a strong combination.

**7. Prepare for WIE Early**: The **Work-Integrated Education** placement is a key differentiator. Start building a CV in Year 1, and seek summer internships in labs or tech companies. PolyU’s career centre offers workshops.
- Target companies like **ASTRI**, **HKSTP**, or **CLP** for physics-related WIE opportunities.

**8. Connect with Current Students**: Join PolyU’s **Physics Society** or **AIDA Club** on social media. Ask about course workload, professors, and internship experiences. This insider knowledge can guide your application.
- Attend PolyU’s **Info Day** (usually October) to meet faculty and ask specific questions about JS3030.

**9. Plan for the Final Year Project (FYP)**: The FYP is a capstone that can showcase your skills to employers. Think about a topic that combines physics with AIDA (e.g., using AI to analyze quantum data) or IE (e.g., commercializing a physics invention).
- Start brainstorming in Year 2, and approach a professor whose research interests you. A strong FYP can lead to publications or job offers.

curriculum.title: 課程結構 — 物理學(榮譽)理學士副主修AIDA/IE
content: **課程概覽**：此為四年全日制課程，結合堅實的物理學基礎與**人工智能及數據分析（AIDA）**或**創新及創業（IE）**副主修。畢業生將獲頒物理學理學士及指定副主修資格，增強跨學科專業能力。
**兩個專修**：學生可選擇**AIDA**（專注人工智能、機器學習及大數據）或**IE**（專注創新、初創管理及科技商業化）。副主修約佔30至36學分。
**第一年**：基礎課程包括**物理學**（力學、電磁學、熱力學）、**數學**（微積分、線性代數）及**大學核心要求**（語文、批判思考）。透過探索性科目初步了解副主修。
**第二年**：核心物理課程包括**量子力學**、**統計物理學**及**計算物理學**。副主修課程正式開始——AIDA學生修讀程式設計及數據結構；IE學生修讀創業學及設計思維。
**第三年**：進階物理選修科（如**固態物理學**、**天體物理學**）及副主修深化。AIDA學生學習深度學習及數據挖掘；IE學生學習風險投資及知識產權。**校企協作教育（WIE）**實習通常於此年進行。
**第四年**：物理學**畢業專題項目**，整合副主修知識。完成剩餘副主修課程及選修科。畢業生已準備好迎接跨學科職業或深造。

career.title: 就業前景 — 物理學 + AIDA/IE 畢業生
content: **高需求行業**：畢業生在**科技**、**金融**、**數據科學**及**研發**領域備受青睞。物理學解難能力結合AIDA或IE技能，開拓**數據科學家**、**量化分析師**及**創新經理**等職位。
**AIDA路徑**：副主修AIDA的典型職位包括**機器學習工程師**、**人工智能專家**及**大數據分析師**，任職於Google、滙豐銀行或本地科技初創。PolyU科學畢業生平均起薪約每月港幣20,000至25,000元。
**IE路徑**：IE副主修為**創業**、**科技諮詢**及**產品管理**做好準備。畢業生可創辦自己的企業，或加入**數碼港**或**香港科學園**等加速器。
**深造機會**：許多畢業生在全球頂尖大學攻讀物理學、數據科學或相關領域的**哲學碩士/博士**，包括PolyU在**光子學**及**材料科學**的研究中心。
**行業聯繫**：PolyU的**校企協作教育（WIE）**計劃將學生安排至**中電**、**港鐵公司**及**應科院**等企業，提供直接行業接觸及人脈網絡機會。
**大灣區機遇**：此課程利用PolyU與**大灣區**的緊密聯繫，提供深圳、廣州及其他創新中心的實習及就業機會。

campus.title: 校園生活與設施 — 理大紅磡
content: **優越地理位置**：理大位於九龍**紅磡**，經**紅磡站**（東鐵線及屯馬線）直達港鐵。校園距離**尖沙咀**及**九龍海濱**僅數分鐘路程。
**科學設施**：**應用物理學系**設有現代化實驗室，用於**激光物理學**、**納米科技**及**材料表徵**。學生可使用**大學研究設施**進行高級實驗。
**圖書館及學習共享空間**：**包玉剛圖書館**藏有大量物理學期刊、電子書及協作空間。**學習共享空間**提供24/7自修區及小組項目室。
**學生住宿**：理大為非本地學生提供校內宿舍，一年級新生可獲優先分配。宿舍步行可達，設有聯誼室、健身室及餐飲設施。
**學會及社團**：**物理學會**舉辦學術講座、實驗室參觀及社交活動。學生亦可加入**AIDA學會**或**創業學會**，與同儕及業界專業人士交流。
**體育及康樂**：校園設有**體育中心**，配備游泳池、籃球場及健身室。附近的**紅磡海濱長廊**適合緩步跑及放鬆。

competitiveness.title: 競爭力與入學 — JS3030
content: **入學分數計算**：**最佳五科**（另加第六科獎勵分）。申請人可選取HKDSE最佳五科成績，第六科可獲額外獎勵分，最大化靈活性。
**科目比重**：物理、數學（必修）及M1/M2獲**較高比重**（通常1.5倍至2倍）。其他科目如化學、生物及英文亦獲較高權重。請查閱理大官方網站了解確切系數。
**平均加權分數（2025年）**：**經科目加權的HKDSE平均分數**為**260.6**。此為競爭性申請者的基準——分數高於此數值可顯著提高機會。
**中位數及下四分位數**：2025年的中位數及下四分位數列為**不適用**，顯示此課程相對較新或數據尚未公布。申請者應以高於平均分數為目標以策安全。
**面試要求**：入圍候選人可能獲邀參加**面試**（通常以英語進行），以評估其動機、解難能力及對物理學和副主修的興趣。請準備討論你的學術背景及職業目標。

alumni.title: 知名校友及成功故事 — 理大物理學
content: **黃志雄教授**：理大應用物理學系講座教授，在**納米光子學**及**等離子體光子學**研究方面享負盛名。畢業於理大物理學課程，現領導前沿研究。
**李嘉強博士**：**滙豐銀行香港**高級數據科學家，專注於**機器學習**進行欺詐檢測。持有物理學理學士學位及數據科學碩士學位。
**陳美玲女士**：**GreenTech Solutions**聯合創辦人，該初創專注於**太陽能優化**。畢業於物理學IE專修，並獲得**理大微型基金**。
**曾偉文博士**：**美國太空總署噴氣推進實驗室**研究科學家，從事**太空儀器**及**遙感**工作。在理大取得物理學博士學位。
**何嘉俊先生**：**高盛香港**量化分析師，運用物理學模型進行**金融風險評估**。畢業於物理學理學士及金融副修。
**譚華耀教授**：理大科學學院院長，在**光纖傳感器**及**光子學**領域獲國際認可。為理大物理學課程的傑出畢業生。

scholarships.title: 獎學金與經濟資助 — 理大
content: **理大入學獎學金**：頒予HKDSE成績優異者（如多科5**或以上）。涵蓋全額或部分學費，最高可達每年**港幣100,000元**，頒予傑出申請人。
**科學學院獎學金**：**科學學院**為學業成績優異的學生（包括JS3030）提供基於成績的獎學金，金額介乎**港幣10,000元至50,000元**。
**吳達倫博士紀念獎學金**：專為物理學成績優異及具研究潛力的學生而設，每年價值**港幣20,000元**。
**校企協作教育（WIE）津貼**：參與WIE實習的學生可獲大學或主辦公司提供的**每月津貼**（最高港幣5,000元），減輕實習期間的經濟負擔。
**政府經濟援助**：合資格學生可申請香港政府的**TSFS**（經入息審查）或**NLSFT**（免入息審查）貸款，以及適用的**準教師獎學金**。
**外部獎學金**：理大物理學學生曾獲**香港博士研究生獎學金計劃**及**裘槎基金會獎學金**等著名獎項，用於深造。

tips.title: Ace Sir JS3030 攻略 — 9 個實用貼士
content: **1. 掌握比重計算公式**：重點投入**物理、數學（必修）及M1/M2**，因它們獲1.5倍至2倍比重。物理科5*比通識科5*更有價值。按此分配溫習時間。
- 使用公式計算加權分數：（科目分數 × 比重）總和取最佳五科，另加第六科獎勵分（原始分5%）。目標加權總分高於**260.6**。
**2. 在物理和數學中脫穎而出**：這些是核心科目。練習歷屆HKDSE試卷，專注**實驗設計**及**數據分析**題目。在此表現優異可彌補選修科弱項。
- 對於M1/M2，掌握微積分及概率——這與AIDA和IE專修直接相關。
**3. 為面試建立強大背景**：如獲面試，準備討論**為何選擇物理學 + AIDA/IE**。閱讀人工智能或創業的最新趨勢。準備一個你解決過的項目或問題的具體例子。
- 練習用英語回答：「物理學原理如何應用於機器學習？」或「描述一個你的創業想法。」
**4. 善用第六科獎勵分**：選修額外科目（如化學、經濟）以提升分數。即使第六科考獲第4級，也可為總分增加**原始分5%**。
- 選擇你能取得至少第4級的科目——不要過度負荷。
**5. 研究副主修選項**：盡早決定**AIDA**或**IE**。AIDA適合對數據科學感興趣的學生；IE適合未來創業者。相應調整你的個人陳述。
- 瀏覽理大網站查看各專修的課程樣本，了解哪個更符合你的目標。
**6. 利用「最佳五科」優勢**：如有弱科（如通識），可從計算中剔除。專注你最強的五科，包括物理和數學。
- 例如：物理5*、數學5、M2 5、化學4、英文4，已是強勁組合。
**7. 提早準備WIE**：**校企協作教育**實習是關鍵優勢。一年級開始建立履歷，暑假尋找實驗室或科技公司的實習。理大就業中心提供工作坊。
- 目標公司如**應科院**、**香港科技園**或**中電**，尋找與物理相關的WIE機會。
**8. 與現屆學生聯繫**：在社交媒體上加入理大**物理學會**或**AIDA學會**。詢問課程負擔、教授及實習經驗。這些內部資訊可指導你的申請。
- 參加理大**資訊日**（通常在十月），與教授會面並詢問JS3030的具體問題。
**9. 規劃畢業專題項目（FYP）**：FYP是展示技能給僱主的總結性項目。思考一個結合物理學與AIDA（如使用人工智能分析量子數據）或IE（如將物理學發明商業化）的主題。
- 在第二年開始構思，並聯繫研究方向與你興趣相符的教授。出色的FYP可帶來出版物或工作機會。
